svg.text: Why ℤ3 is not a Lie group: every neighbourhood of 0 contains a whole subgroup
A point of ℤ3 is an infinite path down the tree, i.e. a digit string ...d2d1d0 in base 3.
The branch below the k-th zero is the subgroup 3kℤ3: it is open, closed and a group.
These subgroups shrink to {0}, so no neighbourhood of 0 is free of subgroups,
and different branches never touch: the space is totally disconnected.
